title: PRA consoles policy: file transfer, clipboard, recording and sharing

scope.statement: A consoles policy rule is assigned to selected privileged consoles and controls file uploads, file downloads, clipboard copy and paste, session recording, session sharing and joining live sessions. The rule's criteria choose application segments and segment groups, with SAML and SCIM or session and user attributes.

quotes: The privileged consoles that you choose to assign a consoles policy rule can be set to inspect and upload files with or without inspection, download files, copy and paste to and from a privileged console, record privileged sessions, and provide monitor and control capabilities for live privileged sessions.
Choose the application segments and segment groups to which this rule applies:

Share Sessions Mode: Select Control to allow other users to be invited to a privileged session, and to transfer mouse and keyboard control to them. Select Monitor to allow permitted users, such as administrators, to join live privileged sessions.
Join Sessions Mode: Enable to join a Privileged Remote Access (PRA) privileged session.
If you are subscribed to Authentication Service for users, the SAML and SCIM Attributes criteria is replaced with Session and User Attributes.

defaults-disabled.statement: File Uploads, File Downloads, Clipboard Copy, Clipboard Paste, Record Sessions, Share Sessions Mode and Join Sessions Mode are each disabled by default.

quotes: File Uploads: Enable to allow uploads. Select Inspect to inspect uploaded files. Enable to allow uploads. By default, this field is disabled.
File Downloads: Enable to allow downloads. By default, this field is disabled.
Clipboard Copy: Enable to allow the copy action from a privileged console. By default, this field is disabled.
Clipboard Paste: Enable to allow the paste action into a privileged console. By default, this field is disabled.
Record Sessions: Enable to record a Privileged Remote Access (PRA) privileged session. By default, this field is disabled.
Join Sessions Mode: Enable to join a Privileged Remote Access (PRA) privileged session. By default, this field is disabled.

Share Sessions Mode: Select Control to allow other users to be invited to a privileged session, and to transfer mouse and keyboard control to them. Select Monitor to allow permitted users, such as administrators, to join live privileged sessions. By default, this field is disabled.

disabled-feature-display.statement: A feature that is disabled in the consoles policy is not displayed to the user, except File Transfer, which is shown but not functional.

quotes: If any of the features are disabled, then they are not displayed, with the exception of the File Transfer feature, which shows if disabled but isn't functional.

live-session-changes.statement: A change to a consoles policy made during a live privileged session is not reflected until a new live session starts.

quotes: If the consoles policy is changed while a live privileged session is in progress, the changes aren't reflected until a new live privileged session is started.

inspect-needs-zia.statement: The Inspect option for file uploads can be selected only if the Internet & SaaS (ZIA) integration was successful, and inspected files are checked inline with the upload. If the inspection detects malware the upload halts and the files are not uploaded.

quotes: You can only select the Inspect option if the Internet & SaaS (ZIA) integration was successful.
If you select the Inspect option, then the files are inspected inline with the uploading process.
If the files inspected have malware detected, then the uploading process halts and the files are not uploaded.

vnc-file-transfer.statement: For a VNC-enabled console, enabling File Uploads or File Downloads requires the target system to run SSH on port 22 with the same credentials as the VNC login. The connection fails when the end user connects to a target with SFTP disabled.

quotes: the target system needs to have SSH enabled on port 22 and must use the same credentials as used for logging into VNC.
that has SFTP disabled and you are attempting to enable File Uploads or File Downloads, the connection fails when the end user attempts to connect.

recording-excludes-transfers.statement: Session recording captures screen output. File transfer and clipboard contents are not recorded, to prevent leaking sensitive information such as passwords.

quotes: Privileged session recording captures the screen outputs. The File Transfer and Clipboard transfers are not recorded during a privileged session recording to prevent leakage of sensitive information like passwords.

share-modes.statement: Share Sessions Mode set to Control lets other users be invited to a session and be given mouse and keyboard control, and set to Monitor lets permitted users such as administrators join live sessions.

quotes: Select Control to allow other users to be invited to a privileged session, and to transfer mouse and keyboard control to them.
Select Monitor to allow permitted users, such as administrators, to join live privileged sessions.

limits.statement: A consoles policy allows 5,000 policy rules and 200 privileged consoles per policy.

quotes: | Consoles Policy | 5,000 policy rules 200 privileged consoles per consoles policy |

prerequisites.statement: Consoles-based control needs the privileged portals and privileged consoles it will be assigned to created first.

quotes: If you want to configure consoles-based control, you must first create the privileged portals and privileged consoles that you want to assign control to.

console-configuration-column.statement: The Consoles Policy page shows each rule's Rule Order (ZPA applies rules in the listed order and the number can be edited by entering a new value) and its Console Configuration, which lists Clipboard Copy, Clipboard Paste, Download, Inspect Upload, Join Sessions, Record Sessions, Share Sessions Control, Share Sessions Monitor and Upload.

quotes: Rule Order: The policy evaluation order number for the rule. Private Access (ZPA) applies policy rules based on the order they are listed here. Change the rule order by clicking on the number and manually entering a new value.

Console Configuration: The console configuration options you have set for that specific policy rule: Clipboard Copy, Clipboard Paste, Download, Inspect Upload, Join Sessions, Record Sessions, Share Sessions Control, Share Sessions Monitor, and Upload.

vnc-realvnc-sftp.statement: For a VNC or RealVNC console with File Transfer in a consoles policy, the SFTP service must be enabled on the VNC or RealVNC server before the consoles policy is created, with SFTP authentication matching the VNC or RealVNC configuration. If SFTP is not configured on the VNC target and a consoles policy with file transfer is configured for the console, end users cannot connect to it.

quotes: If you select VNC or RealVNC and are enabling File Transfer in a consoles policy, the SFTP service needs to be enabled on the VNC or RealVNC server prior to creating the consoles policy, and the authentication for SFTP needs to match the VNC or RealVNC configuration.
If SFTP is not configured, end users cannot connect to the privileged console.
If SFTP is not configured on the VNC target, and a consoles policy with file transfer is configured for the associated privileged console, then end users cannot connect to that privileged console.

vnc-realvnc-sftp.conditions: These pages add RealVNC and name the SFTP service without a port; the port 22 requirement is stated by vnc-file-transfer.

clipboard-direction.statement: Enabling Clipboard Copy lets a user copy functions from Privileged Remote Access to the local system, and enabling Clipboard Paste lets a user paste functions from the local system to PRA. With multiple privileged consoles open, copied text is carried over to all of the Clipboard-enabled privileged consoles.

quotes: If you enable the Clipboard Copy option, you can copy functions from Privileged Remote Access (PRA) to your local system.
If you enable the Clipboard Paste option, you can paste functions from your local system to PRA.
If you have multiple privileged consoles open, copied text is carried over to all of the Clipboard-enabled privileged consoles.

clipboard-limits.statement: Clipboard operations work only when the selected protocol and remote OS allow them. Non-ASCII characters cannot be copied and pasted if the console uses a VNC, RealVNC or SSH protocol, and operations between a non-Windows OS and a Windows OS can add newline characters. Up to 4,096 characters can be copied and pasted by default, and a larger size of up to 32K characters can be requested through Zscaler Support.

quotes: You can only use Clipboard operations when the selected protocol and remote OS allow it.
You cannot copy and paste non-ASCII characters with the Clipboard feature if the privileged console is using a VNC protocol, RealVNC protocol, or an SSH protocol.
Clipboard operations between a non-Windows OS and a Windows OS can lead to additional newline characters, as Windows uses a different newline character format.
You can copy and paste up to 4,096 characters by default. If you need a larger clipboard size, you can request an increase of up to 32K characters by contacting Zscaler Support.

clipboard-new-session.statement: When the Clipboard features are enabled in a consoles policy, a new session must be started before the Clipboard permissions take effect, and refreshing the page also refreshes the permissions. If a session is already running when Clipboard is started, the user must terminate it and start a new session to show the Clipboard icon.

quotes: When you enable the Clipboard features in a consoles policy, a new session must be started before the Clipboard permissions take effect. Refreshing the page also refreshes the permissions.
If you have a current session running and you start Clipboard, then you must terminate the existing session and start a new session to show the Clipboard icon.

clipboard-sync-and-tamper.statement: When Clipboard is enabled, copied content is periodically synced to the privileged console Clipboard if the browser supports it, and websites or other applications on the device can modify the Clipboard before it is pasted into the console.

quotes: When Clipboard is enabled, the copied content is periodically synced to the privileged console Clipboard if the browser you are using supports it.
Websites or other applications on your device can modify the Clipboard before it is pasted into the privileged console.

clipboard-browsers.statement: When Clipboard Copy and Paste are enabled the functions depend on the browser. In Safari only the Clipboard window can copy and paste within the console; in Chrome a pop-up appears on a paste from the local Clipboard and the user clicks Allow; for pasting from Firefox into the console, dom.events.testing.asyncClipboard and dom.events.asyncClipboard.readText must be set to true on the about:config page.

quotes: When the Clipboard Copy and Paste features are enabled, the Clipboard functions are dependent upon the browser you are using.
If you are using Safari, you can only use the Clipboard window to do copy and paste operations within the privileged console.

If you are using Chrome and have copied from the local system Clipboard and are pasting into the privileged console, a pop-up message from your Chrome browser appears when you attempt the paste operation by keyboard or via the privileged console Clipboard.
Click Allow to complete the paste.
If you are copying from the Firefox browser and want to paste into the privileged console, you need to complete additional configurations on the Firefox side:
In the Firefox browser, go to the about:config page.
Set the following options to true:
dom.events.testing.asyncClipboard
dom.events.asyncClipboard.readText

refresh-applies-policy.summary: Whether a consoles-policy change reaches a live session without a new session: the Configuring Consoles Policies article says changes are not reflected until a new live session is started, and the Clipboard article says refreshing the page also refreshes the permissions.

quotes: If the consoles policy is changed while a live privileged session is in progress, the changes aren't reflected until a new live privileged session is started.

positions.says: A change made during a live session is not reflected until a new live session is started (claim live-session-changes).

quotes: When you enable the Clipboard features in a consoles policy, a new session must be started before the Clipboard permissions take effect. Refreshing the page also refreshes the permissions.

positions.says: For the Clipboard features, a new session must be started before permissions take effect, and refreshing the page also refreshes the permissions (claim clipboard-new-session).

refresh-applies-policy.impact: It is not settled whether a page refresh starts a new session, so it is not settled whether a refresh applies a consoles-policy change. An answer about a policy change that has not taken effect should not state either as fact. A lab test of a change followed by a refresh would settle it.

clipboard-disabled-display.summary: Whether a disabled consoles-policy feature is displayed to the user: the PRA overview says disabled features are not displayed except File Transfer, and the Clipboard article says Clipboard options are disabled by default but the Clipboard icon can still be clicked.

quotes: If any of the features are disabled, then they are not displayed, with the exception of the File Transfer feature, which shows if disabled but isn't functional.

positions.says: Disabled features are not displayed, except File Transfer (claim disabled-feature-display).

quotes: Clipboard options are disabled by default, but you can still click the Clipboard icon.

positions.says: Clipboard options are disabled by default and the Clipboard icon can still be clicked.

clipboard-disabled-display.impact: The Clipboard article also says that with a session already running the user must start a new session to show the Clipboard icon, so it is not settled when the icon is shown. An answer about a missing or clickable Clipboard icon should not rest on either page alone.

clipboard-size-scope.title: Whether the Clipboard size increase is per tenant or per console
clipboard-size-scope.detail: The Clipboard article says Zscaler Support can raise the limit from 4,096 to up to 32K characters but does not say whether the increase applies per tenant or per console. A support request would resolve it.
